description: Minimized inputs promoted out of the structured fuzzers into a permanent replay corpus. Every entry is the smallest input that still reproduces the behaviour it records. All three layers replay this file: backend/test_verifier_fuzz.py, frontend/src/verifierInputs.fuzz.test.ts, contracts/contracts/harpocrates-registry/src/test_fuzz.rs.
policy: Append only. When a fuzz run finds an input that crashes, hangs, leaks, or classifies inconsistently across layers, minimize it and add it here with an issue reference in `description`. Never delete an entry; if a rule intentionally changes, bump `version` and record the migration in docs/zk-fuzzing.md.

entries.description: Zero-length frame: the smallest input that must not reach field parsing.
Off-by-one truncation, the classic framing boundary.
Off-by-one extension: a trailing byte must not be silently ignored.
Two valid frames concatenated: a length check enforcing only a lower bound would accept this.
credential_root set to exactly the BN254 modulus. A '<=' comparison instead of '<' accepts this.
Single high bit set in the video_hash_hi padding region; reachable only by a field-aware mutator.
Zero nullifier: replay protection disabled if accepted.
Revocation domain separator differing only in its final byte; a prefix-only comparison accepts this.
Proof blob one byte under the accepted floor.
Proof blob one byte over the accepted ceiling.
Odd-length proof hex: decode must reject before any byte materialisation.
Non-hex characters in the proof blob; must never reach size checks.
Empty proof hex decodes to zero bytes and must hit the undersize floor.
